# Data provenance

Every file under `data/` is either generated from a checked-in seed by `foundry data build`, or is a curated seed table written for this repository. No third-party dataset is copied into the tree. Where a public sample database informed the shape of a table, it is cited as a modelling reference and the rows remain synthetic.

## Committed artifacts

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Table and column names were rewritten, the schema reduced to nineteen tables, and every row is generated. No data, DDL or .bak content copied. | `src/contoso_foundry/data/model.py` |

## External datasets, fetched but never committed

These corpora are useful for evaluating agent behaviour but cannot be redistributed here. Their sources and versions are recorded for operators who are separately authorized to stage them in a gitignored cache. This repository does not download them, and nothing derived from them is committed.

| Dataset | Source | Licence | Pinned version | Why it is not committed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) | [google-research-datasets/dstc8-schema-guided-dialogue](https://github.com/google-research-datasets/dstc8-schema-guided-dialogue) | CC-BY-SA-4.0 | `d1d3d6f5cd2f0a5b0a5e0a0e5b6e8b1a (tag: master, pinned in data/external/manifest.yaml)` | Share-alike. A transformed derivative committed here would place a copyleft obligation on this repository. |
| MS MARCO | [microsoft.github.io/msmarco](https://microsoft.github.io/msmarco/) | MSMARCO-Non-Commercial | `v2.1` | Non-commercial terms are incompatible with an unrestricted public repository. |
| GAIA benchmark | [huggingface.co/datasets/gaia-benchmark/GAIA](https://huggingface.co/datasets/gaia-benchmark/GAIA) | Gated-Registration-Required | `2023-11` | Access is gated behind acceptance of terms, so the content cannot be mirrored into a public repository. |
